name: Traveller 3 · Helmeted rider
description: Helmeted downhill rider with a skinned body, shared 24-joint humanoid skeleton and nine authored animation clips. This is the source rig used by the Fjordfall Traveller characters.
attribution: Traveller 3 · Helmeted rider by Jonathan Maddison, Generated Assets (CC-BY-4.0). Model created with Meshy.

source.description: Meshy rig, refined and animated in Blender 5.2 through Blender Lab MCP

notes: Authored clips included; game IK, foot contact solving and cloth shaders are not included.
